final: WITH project_funding_qc AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) as project_count FROM scanqc q INNER JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(project_count) as total_projects, COUNT(*) as num_funding_sources FROM project_funding_qc) SELECT pf.fundflux, pf.project_count, CAST(pf.project_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_projects as fraction_of_total, CAST(pf.project_count AS FLOAT) / (CAST(t.total_projects AS FLOAT) / t.num_funding_sources) as divided_by_average FROM project_funding_qc pf CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY pf.fundflux
